air-040.ref: REV1 Systems Guide p.4 · DSC-21-20-10, DSC-21-20-40
air-040.quote: Cabin Pressurization Modes · AUTO: Normal mode of operation. 2 CPC’s (Cabin Pressure Controllers). 2 Outflow valves, each with 2 motors that are used for the AUTO modes. Uses FMGC provided landing elevation for the entered destination. · SEMI-AUTOMATIC: Used when operating at airport not in database. Use the LDG ELEV selector to set destination elevation. Uses the same two CPCs and motors as the auto mode. · MANUAL: Set MODE SEL to Manual and use VALVE SEL and V/S CTL to adjust pressurization per ECAM procedure. The target cabin altitudes are provided in the FCOM and on the STS page. Each Outflow valve has a third motor for Manual mode use. Each toggle of the V/S CTL equals about 150-200fpm change.
air-040.note: Training-guide wording (A330 System Operational Knowledge Guide Rev 1, 24JUN2024). Confirm in the FCOM at the DSC reference; the FCOM is the primary document.

eca-449.quote: The EMER CANC Pb affects the following: · Warnings: Silences the warning for as long as the failure continues. Extinguishes the Master Warning lights.
